QuestionStmt.S: Which of the following set of elements is present in apatite?

Solution.S: Apatite is a group of phosphate minerals with the general formula Ca₅(PO₄)₃(F, Cl, OH). The essential elements present in apatite are calcium (Ca), phosphorus (P), and oxygen (O). Therefore, the correct set is Ca, P, and O, which corresponds to option B.
